evidence.title: GitHub - chakra-ui/ark: Unstyled, accessible UI components for your design System. Works in React, Vue, Solid, and Svelte.

name: Ark UI
summary: Headless, unstyled UI components with the same API for React, Vue, Solid and Svelte, built on Zag.js.
description: 45+ accessible, unstyled components — accordion, dialog, combobox, date picker, color picker, navigation menu, file upload and more — with a consistent API across React, Solid, Vue and Svelte. WAI-ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation and focus management are built in via Zag.js state machines; styling is left to Tailwind, Panda CSS, CSS-in-JS or plain CSS. Maintained by the Chakra UI team under MIT.
contains: 45+ components across navigation, overlays, forms, data display and utilities
same component API in React, Solid, Vue and Svelte packages
built on Zag.js finite state machines
WAI-ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, RTL support
MIT licensed, maintained by the Chakra UI team
